theorems.name: Submission.dph_sh_covectorEuclideanNorm_interior_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl m') (k + 1)) (w : Eucl m') (T : Eucl m →L[ℝ] Eucl m') (a : ℝ) (β : Covector (Eucl m) k), (∀ v : Fin k → Eucl m, β v = a * γ (Fin.cons w (fun i => T (v i)))) → covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ |a| * Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖w‖ * ‖T‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
